import json, os
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==3 for v in grid[r])]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==3 for r in range(h))]
    cr,cc=rows[0],cols[0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r==cr or c==cc: continue
            d=max(abs(r-cr),abs(c-cc))
            out[r][c]=4 if d%2==0 else 0
    return out
